question: What's the multi-language sales infrastructure for APAC/EMEA without hiring 10 extra support people?
answer:
## Answer

Multi-language sales collateral at scale breaks without templating infrastructure. Most teams hire **translator for each language** (cost: **$4K–$8K per language per quarter**). Better: **templated content system + contractor translation layer**.

Language infrastructure playbook:

**Tier 1 (Must-Translate):**
- Website homepage + demo video subtitles: **English → FR, DE, ES, PT, JA, ZH, KO** (7 languages, **1 translation per year**)
- Sales deck + ROI calculator: **English → FR, DE, ES, JA** (4 languages, **2 updates/year**)
- Email sequences + follow-up: **English → FR, DE, ES, JA** (translate only **win/loss email templates**, not 1:1 customer emails)
- Cost: **$12K–$18K/year** (fixed template translation)

**Tier 2 (Contractor-Led):**
- Customer-specific proposals: **English template → contractor translates** (AE provides industry + company context, **translator fills in 20–30 min**, not rebuild from scratch)
- Sales call notes + post-meeting recaps: **English summary → AE** (contractor translates only if deal >$50K)
- Cost: **$3K–$6K/month** (contractor on retainer, ad-hoc proposals)

**Tier 3 (AI-Assisted):**
- Live chat transcripts, quick Slack translations, one-off support docs: **Google Translate API + review pass by AE**
- Cost: **<$500/month** (API only, no review labor)

## Translation Effort Matrix

| Content | Languages | Frequency | Annual Cost | Owner |
|---------|-----------|-----------|-------------|-------|
| Website | 7 | 1x/year | $12K | Marketing |
| Sales Deck | 4 | 2x/year | $8K | Sales Enablement |
| Email Templates | 4 | 2x/year | $4K | Marketing Ops |
| Proposals (Ad-hoc) | 4 | 40x/year | $18K | Sales (Contractor) |
| **Total** | — | — | **~$42K/year** | — |

    Tier 2: Template + Contractor

        40 docs/year

        Reuse for All Regions
    Tier 3: AI-Assisted

        Minimal Review

Template-first model saves **60%** vs. hiring language specialists. Why? **80% of sales content is repetitive** (deck, ROI calc, email, proposal structure). Translate the template **once per quarter**; reuse for all deals. AE customization (company name, numbers) happens in English; contractor translates only the **core template frame**, not customized proposal.

OpenView's Sales Ops research: **Teams with <$30M ARR** that hire 1 translator per language spend **$48K–$72K/year** and still have 2–4 week translation lag. Teams using **templated content + contractor layer** spend **$36K–$42K** and deliver translations in **24–48 hours**.

Force Management note: **Sales methodology translations** (MEDDPICC, Challenger discovery) must be done by **certified regional trainers** ($30K–$50K one-time), not generic translators. This is non-negotiable for ramp quality.

AI assist: Google Translate API now handles **95% accuracy** for templated sales language (no domain jargon). Use for proposals <$30K; hire contractor for $100K+.
